name: Thinking Mode
content:
"""
title: Thinking Mode
description: Toggle thinking mode via reasoning_effort
"""

from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import Optional


class Filter:
    class Valves(BaseModel):
        pass

    def __init__(self):
        self.valves = self.Valves()
        self.toggle = True  # 在聊天輸入區顯示為可點擊按鈕
        self.icon = "data:image/svg+xml;base64,"  # lucide "brain-circuit" icon (ISC), self-contained data URI

    def inlet(self, body: dict, __user__: Optional[dict] = None) -> dict:
        # 只有使用者點亮按鈕時才會執行到這裡
        body["reasoning_effort"] = "high"  # vLLM 會轉成 enable_thinking=true
        return body

meta.description: Toggle Gemma 4 thinking mode via reasoning_effort
